description: Run an extraction (standardization) on one uploaded, fully processed document and wait for the result. Use extract instead when starting from a file. Credits: upload 1/page for PDF, image, Word and HTML (CSV, Excel, JSON, text and XML upload free); extraction 2/page at standard effort, 4/page at high effort, 3/page with citations (always standard effort). Without a schema, drafting one costs 1 credit per page on at most the first 5 pages. Creating a schema from json_schema is free.

citations.description: Cite every value to its place on the page (bounding box and confidence). Runs at standard effort, 3 credits/page.

effort_level.description: Extraction effort. 'standard' (default) is right for most documents; use 'high' only after standard missed or misread values.

save_to.description: Optional path to write the extracted JSON to, relative to the working directory.

schema_id.description: Saved schema; omit to have DocuPipe draft one from the document.

name: standardize
title: Extract data from an uploaded document
